A very special island is inhabited only by knights and knaves. Knights always tell the truth, and knaves always lie. You meet 5 inhabitants: Ella, Harper, Samuel, Grace, and James. Ella said that (Harper is a knight and James is a knight and Ella is a knight) and (Samuel is a knave or Grace is a knave) and (James is a knave if and only if James is a knight). Harper told you that (if Samuel is a knight then Samuel is a knave) if and only if (Ella is a knave). Samuel remarked, "(Ella is a knave or Grace is a knave) if and only if (if Ella is a knave then Ella is a knight)". As Grace put it, "Samuel is a knave". In James's words: "if James is a knight then (Ella is a knave or Samuel is a knave)". So who is a knight and who is a knave? (Format your answer like: "Ella is a knight/knave, Harper is a knight/knave, Samuel is a knight/knave, Grace is a knight/knave, and James is a knight/knave")
